content_sections.heading: IGH Dwarka Senior Resident Vacancy Details 2026
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IGH Dwarka Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the IGH Dwarka recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the Indira Gandhi Hospital (IGH Dwarka) recruitment is Senior Resident.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Senior Resident post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The required qualification for the Senior Resident post is MDS (Orthodontics).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Resident post is 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Senior Resident position ranges from Rs. 67,700 to Rs. 2,08,700 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q7. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 30-07-2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number is No.2/16(30)/Estt./Appt./SR/2026-IGH/11892-97.
